frozen_design_summary: three proof layers L1 raw capture / L2 host receipt / L3 publication; a later signature never upgrades an earlier layer's fact (A-D3)
host_signed only from a verified L3 attestation record; L1+L2 fully signed is not sufficient

provider protocol: one-shot subprocess, exact field sets, byte-identical echo of request_id/payload_sha256/domain_separator, rc=0, stdout<=L bytes, timeout T, all failures fail closed (L and T are parameters, see OPEN-D7)

no existence-based capability: file-exists/executable/is-a-.py is never sufficient; attestation_capability() becomes a successful-handshake predicate; failure codes split E01 (unset) / E02 (path missing or unopenable) / E32 (exists but signing capability unproven, e.g. sys.executable)

trust domain tuple: fingerprint in list AND issuer equals the key's declared issuer AND now within [not_before,not_after] AND status==active; entries are a closed named field set including a mandatory-but-nullable revoked_at

canonical signed bytes: canonical_sha256(payload) as 64-char ascii hex; payload field set is exact and carries 4 version fields; signature/result_sha256/publication_receipt are excluded to avoid self-reference

replay vs expiry: historical re-verification of the same immutable artifact must always pass; expires_at constrains publish time only (window W, see OPEN-D7); cross-payload/version/issuer/domain replay is rejected; request_id is one-shot but never gates historical verification

legacy boundary: G1 read-only (explicit set 3.0..3.6) / G2 re-verifiable / G3a no signing claim, preserved / G3b claims host_signed without a record, rejected as G4 / G4 reject with a specific code from decision.md section 2.5
F01/F02 preservative freeze plus new order: validate -> sign -> validate receipt -> register -> write output -> roll back registration on write failure (rollback is I-09-A)
forbidden for the implementer: self-signed self-trust, network key service, test keys in the repository trust domain, environment=test keys on the production path
